skills.name: Built-In Machine Gun
skills.description: Summons Akatsuki Follow-Up Specs.  Attacks with machine gun.  Bad effects on enemies.  *Stuns enemies (6 sec) *Enemy Skill Use Rate -40% (6 sec) *ATK x 4000% Area Damage

skills.name: Pizza Order
skills.description: Sits down and eats tasty-looking pizza.  Good effects on allies.    *Removes allies' debuffs  *Skill Hit Rate +40% (7 sec) *Hit Rate +40% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion
abilities.description: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Silence: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making all Agility type enemies' Skills unusable and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
